cwe_content.cwe: CWE-668,Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere

candidate.Reason: The code allows serving resources from the classloader using getResource() with user-controlled input (filenameWithPath), which can expose internal application classes and resources to unauthorized access via crafted HTTP requests
The webjar path correction mechanism processes user-controlled input and could potentially be exploited to access unintended resources through path manipulation attacks
The webjar path validation logic processes user-controlled input and could allow unauthorized resource access through path manipulation, exposing resources to the wrong security sphere
